statement: ∀ [hc : CharP K p], ∃ κ : R p →+* K, (∀ (a b : ℤ) (r : R p), (r : ℚ) = (a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ) → ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b → κ r = (a : K) * (b : K)⁻¹) ∧ ∃ S : Submonoid ℤ, IsLocalization S (R p)
proof:
intro hc
  classical
  let S : Submonoid ℤ := (IsUnit.submonoid K).comap (Int.castRingHom K)
  have hS (b : ℤ) : b ∈ S ↔ ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b := by
    change IsUnit (b : K) ↔ _
    rw [isUnit_iff_ne_zero, ne_eq, CharP.intCast_eq_zero_iff K p]
  have hb0 (b : ℤ) (hb : b ∈ S) : (b : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (fun hz : b = 0 => (hS b).mp hb (hz ▸ dvd_zero _))
  letI : IsLocalization S (R p) := by
    refine (isLocalization_iff S (R p)).mpr ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro b
      let t : R p := ⟨(b.val : ℚ)⁻¹, Subring.subset_closure ⟨b.val, (hS b.val).mp b.property, rfl⟩⟩
      apply isUnit_iff_exists_inv.mpr
      refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (b.val : ℚ) * (b.val : ℚ)⁻¹ = 1
      exact mul_inv_cancel₀ (hb0 b.val b.property)
    · intro r
      obtain ⟨a, b, hb, hr⟩ := (h_T008.1 (r : ℚ)).mp r.property
      refine ⟨(a, ⟨b, (hS b).mpr hb⟩), ?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (r : ℚ) * (b : ℚ) = (a : ℚ)
      rw [hr, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hb0 b ((hS b).mpr hb))]
    · intro a b hab
      refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
      have he : a = b := by
        have heq := congrArg (fun r : R p => (r : ℚ)) hab
        exact_mod_cast heq
      simp [he]
  have hu : ∀ b : S, IsUnit (Int.castRingHom K b) := fun b => b.property
  let κ : R p →+* K := IsLocalization.lift hu
  refine ⟨κ, ?_, S, inferInstance⟩
  intro a b r hr hb
  have hbr : r * (b : R p) = (a : R p) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (r : ℚ) * (b : ℚ) = (a : ℚ)
    rw [hr, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hb0 b ((hS b).mpr hb))]
  have hk : κ r * (b : K) = (a : K) := by
    simpa using congrArg κ hbr
  rw [← div_eq_mul_inv]
  exact (eq_div_iff (by simpa [CharP.intCast_eq_zero_iff K p] using hb)).mpr hk

checked : ∀ (p : ℕ) (K : Type) [instK : Field K] (l : ℤ) (V : Type) [instV : AddCommGroup V]
  [instCV : _root_.Module ℂ V] (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  Nat.Prime p ∧ CharP K p →
    ((∀ (q : ℚ), q ∈ scalarRing p ↔ ∃ a b, ¬↑p ∣ b ∧ q = ↑a / ↑b) ∧
        ((∃ ι, iotaSpec p M ι ∧ Function.Injective ⇑ι ∧ ι.range = L p M) ∧
            Nonempty (Module.Basis (Ix l) (R p) (MR p M)) ∧
              Submodule.span ℂ ↑M = ⊤ ∧
                (∀ (r : ℕ), Preserves M (divided x r) ∧ Preserves M (divided y r)) ∧
                  Preserves M x ∧
                    Preserves M y ∧
                      Preserves M h ∧
                        (∀ (r : ℕ), (∀ u ∈ L p M, (divided x r) u ∈ L p M) ∧ ∀ u ∈ L p M, (divided y r) u ∈ L p M) ∧
                          (∀ u ∈ L p M, x u ∈ L p M ∧ y u ∈ L p M ∧ h u ∈ L p M) ∧
                            (∃ fx fy fh, LiftOf M x fx ∧ LiftOf M y fy ∧ LiftOf M h fh) ∧
                              ∃ DX DY, ∀ (r : ℕ), LiftOf M (divided x r) (DX r) ∧ LiftOf M (divided y r) (DY r)) ∧
          (∀ (B : Module.Basis (Ix l) ℂ V),
              (∀ (i : Ix l), B i = ev y v ↑i) →
                divided y l.toNat * divided x l.toNat = matrixUnit B (Fin.last l.toNat) (Fin.last l.toNat) ∧
                  (∀ (i : Ix l),
                      divided x (l.toNat - ↑i) * (divided y l.toNat * divided x l.toNat) =
                        matrixUnit B i (Fin.last l.toNat)) ∧
                    (∀ (j : Ix l),
                        divided y l.toNat * divided x l.toNat * divided y (l.toNat - ↑j) =
                          ↑(l.toNat.choose ↑j) • matrixUnit B (Fin.last l.toNat) j) ∧
                      ∀ (j : Ix l), IsUnit ↑(l.toNat.choose ↑j)) ∧
            ∀ (B : Module.Basis (Ix l) ℂ V),
              (∀ (i : Ix l), B i = ev y v ↑i) →
                ∀ (i j : Ix l),
                  matrixUnit B i j =
                      (↑(l.toNat.choose ↑j))⁻¹ •
                        (divided x (l.toNat - ↑i) * (divided y l.toNat * divided x l.toNat) *
                          divided y (l.toNat - ↑j)) ∧
                    ∀ u ∈ L p M, (matrixUnit B i j) u ∈ L p M) →
      ∀ [hc : CharP K p],
        ∃ κ, (∀ (a b : ℤ) (r : R p), ↑r = ↑a / ↑b → ¬↑p ∣ b → κ r = ↑a * (↑b)⁻¹) ∧ ∃ S, IsLocalization S (R p)
